description:
Upload ANY file; the system decides what it is (the unified intake queue,
the web app's Documents > Upload). ``file_base64``: raw bytes, base64.

Prefer this unless plainly an invoice; always for bank statements (CAMT.053
XML, PDF, CSV or .xlsx; not legacy .xls), matched to the registered bank account
by IBAN; journal/accounting exports; balance sheets, P&L and VAT filings. A
mixed .zip is routed per file.

Returns 202 and the queue row; poll ``get_intake`` for the outcome and targets.
An unroutable file fails with its reason, never dropped.
name: upload_intake
